name: screeps-arena-game-api-cpp
description: Write Screeps: Arena bots in C++ (WASM), with a local simulator

scripts.build:fixtures: scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --preset wasm && scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --build --preset wasm
scripts.test: npm run test:cpp && npm run test:sim && npm run test:external
scripts.test:cpp: cmake --preset native && cmake --build --preset native && ctest --preset native
scripts.test:sim: npm run build:fixtures && node --test tests/constants.test.mjs tests/engine.test.mjs tests/harness.test.mjs tests/world.test.mjs
